title: Feeder-free, Xeno-free Generation of Cortical Spheroids  From Human Pluripotent Stem Cells
protocol: Maintain feeder-free hiPSC by culturing on vitronectin in Essential 8™ medium.
Dilute 60 μl of vitronectin in 6 ml DPBS to a 1:100 dilution.
Add 1 ml of diluted vitronectin solution per well and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Aspirate the medium, rinse with 3–4 ml DPBS per well.
Add 1 ml of 0.5 mM EDTA to each well and incubate for 7 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate the EDTA solution, add 2 ml of pre-warmed E8 medium to each well.
Remove cells by gently squirting the medium and pipetting the colonies with a 5 ml serological pipette.
Avoid generating bubbles during the process.
Aspirate any residual vitronectin solution from the pre-coated dish.
Add 2 ml of pre-warmed E8 medium to each well containing the cell suspension.
Gently invert several times to mix the cell suspension.
Transfer the appropriate volume into each well containing pre-warmed E8 medium according to the desired split ratio.
Place the plate in a 37°C, 5% CO₂ incubator.
Do not change the media on the day of passage.
Replace the medium daily with 2–2.5 ml per well after the day of passage.
Regularly check cultures for Mycoplasma contamination and genomic abnormalities.
Pre-treat hiPSC with 1% DMSO two days prior to neural differentiation and one day prior to spheroid formation.
Passage hPSC from a 6-well plate to a 100 mm culture dish.
Culture hPSC to 80-90% confluency.
Pre-warm E8 medium, Accutase, and DMEM/F-12 at room temperature.
Supplement E8 medium with ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 to a final concentration of 10 μM.
Add 1 ml of E8 supplemented with Y-27632 per well in the AggreWell plate.
Centrifuge the AggreWell plate at 2,000 x g for 5 minutes to remove air bubbles.
Check under the microscope to ensure bubbles have been removed from microwells.
Set the plate in an incubator while preparing single cell suspensions of hPSC.
Aspirate maintenance medium from the hPSC plates.
Rinse cells twice with DPBS without calcium and magnesium.
Add 4 ml of Accutase per 100 mm culture plate.
Incubate for 7 minutes at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Add pre-warmed E8 medium up to 10 ml volume.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 200 x g for 4 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet with E8 medium and count cell number.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 200 x g for 4 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet with pre-warmed EB medium supplemented with Y-27632 to obtain 3 million cells per 1 ml of medium.
Add 1 ml of this cell suspension to the previously prepared AggreWell plate, which contains 1 ml of E8 medium.
Centrifuge the AggreWell™800 plate at 100 x g for 3 minutes to distribute the cells in the microwells.
Incubate the plate for 24 hours at 37°C in a 5% CO₂ incubator.
Harvest the hPSC-derived spheroids from the microwells by firmly pipetting the medium in the well up and down with a 1 ml plastic tip that has been cut.
Place a 40 μm strainer on a 50 ml conical tube and pass the suspension of spheroids through the strainer.
Pipette 1 ml of DMEM/F-12 medium across the entire surface of the well to dislodge any remaining spheroids. Collect the spheroids and pass over the strainer as described.
Repeat step for dislodging and harvesting until all aggregates are removed from the wells, typically 3–5 times.
Invert the strainer and place it over a new 50 ml conical tube.
Collect the spheroids by washing with Essential 6™ \(E6) medium for neural induction.
Observe the AggreWell™800 plate under the microscope to ensure that all aggregates have been removed from the wells. Repeat wash if necessary.
Place harvested spheroids in ultra-low attachment 100 mm plates in E6 medium supplemented with 2.5 μM Dorsomorphin and 10 μM SB-431542.
Optionally, add 2.5 μM XAV-939 to the E6 medium for the first five days.
Change media daily except on day one.
Replace E6 medium containing Dorsomorphin and SB-431542 with neural medium supplemented with 20 ng/ml EGF2 and 20 ng/ml FGF2 on day six.
Change the medium daily in the first ten days, then every other day for subsequent nine days after switching to neural medium.
Replace FGF2 and EGF2 with BDNF and NT-3 at concentrations of 20 ng/ml each starting from day twenty-five.
Change media every other day from day twenty-five onwards.
Use only neural medium without growth factors from day forty-three onwards, changing the medium every four days or as needed.
